title: Deputy CM Sachin Pilot is addressing in Meena Samaj program
description: News18 Rajasthan is one of the India’s leading news channel. Please follow up page to watch live and breaking news with latest videos added every hour.   Please visit our news18rajasthan.com for latest opinions and detailed news coverage. asr.full_text: Welcome to Vaskar News 18 update I am Pajit Ansari Chowmo walking with you wherever. The Depricium Secretariat pilot is present and you should do the same with Padri as Id Bhavasa who made this statement. The question will be: how will you discourage the purchase of land with houses on Peta Pena Dua Mala Pena Dua? You should all thank Ramesh Minaji because he told me that you have to come here. After all, or even if you didn't do anything to me, you had already put in the agenda and then Ramesh Minaji. He told me that you should come to this event and he especially pressured me to the Lok Sabha. I want to thank Praatap Singh Ji and Govin Ji for the seriousness with which you were listening. We have seen all the demands you had. And I want to assure you with this in mind at least that this very long unnecessary dispute was drawn up in the foreign government. Meena and Meenawala this dispute was not a problem and the government has cancelled it even today. If any official in Rajasthan abroad, any officer in Rajasthan abroad has any problem, please tell us to come to any problem we don't want our young people in Rajasthan to have. I have told the officials to the government again all the time because there is no dispute and no dispute that is going on. But we will not need to ask the government to stop any of the people in Rajasthan abroad. If there is any problem, please let us know that the whole government stands with you and friends we have many choices we have to face the choices that are caused by the unnecessary disputes that no one can get any profit from. If there is anything to be done to the government, the government should immediately have an effect clarification must be ordered by the government. Yes but also personally all the ministerial matters that are present I personally can anywhere. So what is the bad thing that this country has done in two months that when it met the beneficiaries it boasted about the farmers in Maharashtra in Uttar Pradesh and we in Rajasthan apologize for the bad things they do and they have created Brahma that through Swastika mantra they help people that the foreign government is not giving us a list of what we want to pay the farmers in the amount of money we want to pay and Rs. 2,000 in the Rs. 2,000 in the Rs. 2,000 in the Rs. And you promised to double the amount of the farmer's ammunition. You are paying him Rs.2000. So it does not fill the stomachs of the people with speeches. I don't know yet. I was in a meeting somewhere. So someone said that the Sahib wants to take advantage of this. And I am saddened that Watvaran has become a devious spirit, a miserable spirit, a poisonous one. There was opposition before, but the vocabulary was different. No one spoke of sweating. No one spoke of making a congressional book. Whether it was Vajpayee or any other leader. This has created a climate of hatred for one another is not a good sign for the country. The sanctities we have worked hard for 60-70 years to make those sanctities a constant hook in the lifeboat. But you all because you are a citizen, there will be elections in the coming time. You have to review how many people have kept their promises. And like our Lord Govin said, the government has started talking about increasing the pension in the ministry where I am working. My has ended. I have six to eight families of people in the month of November figures. I want to thank you all and thank you for the long speech you gave, Mr. Mars. Thank you for the long speech you gave, Mr. Mars.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents news coverage of a deputy chief minister speaking at a Meena Samaj community event. The speech concerns government decisions, public demands, officials, and political issues, with no observed financial or data-related offer. Requests to follow, subscribe, like, and visit the news outlet are channel-promotion actions rather than financial solicitation or a deceptive mechanism.
